d: Platinum white hair is styled with messy, wind-swept bangs and a long, thick braid draped over the shoulder. The eyes are golden-yellow with a calm, half-lidded expression, set upon a face with a mature, young adult appearance. The body has a slender build with a prominent chest, dressed in a white high-collared outfit featuring gold trim, a blue glowing circular gem at the center of the chest, and a flowing white cape.
